explanations.1: This checks if the Apache server has the PHP 5 module installed before trying to use PHP commands; if it doesn't have it, Apache will skip this whole block.
explanations.2: This tells PHP to show error messages directly in the browser output instead of hiding them.
explanations.4: This enables PHP to keep track of the last error that occurred so you can access it later in your code.
explanations.5: This tells PHP to write error messages to a file called error.log instead of (or in addition to) showing them on screen.
